cohort: 380 infants born after 35 weeks of gestation who were 2-14 days old and had bilirubin levels higher than 17 mg/dl and underwent exchange transfusion
finding: The most prevalent risk factors for hyperbilirubinemia requiring exchange transfusion were RH incompatibility, ABO incompatibility, and G6PD deficiency.
mod_finding: Mean levels of serum bilirubin were similar in neonates born by cesarean section and normal vaginal delivery (P=0.458).
